name: ansible-lens
description: Zero-dependency, cross-platform, static-metadata Ansible Language Server & Linter. Ansible Lens is an independent, community-built extension and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Red Hat, Inc. Ansible® is a registered trademark of Red Hat, Inc.

ansibleLens.lint.enabled.description: Enable or disable static Ansible linting and project integrity checks.

ansibleLens.lint.profile.description: Lint strictness profile (`minimal`, `basic`, `moderate`, or `production`). In `production` mode, warning-level lint rules are elevated to errors.

ansibleLens.lint.extraVars.description: List of extra variable names (passed at runtime via `-e` / `--extra-vars` or CI) to exempt from `undefined-variable` warnings.

ansibleLens.metadata.autoDownload.description: Automatically lazy-download unloaded collection metadata packs (e.g. `ansible.posix.json.gz`) in the background on first FQCN encounter with SHA-256 verification.

ansibleLens.metadata.manifestUrl.description: Remote or internal mirror URL for `manifest.json` and `.json.gz` collection metadata packs.

ansibleLens.jinja.autoSpaceBraces.description: Automatically pad empty Jinja2 expression braces `{{|}}` to `{{ | }}` when pressing Space, and collapse both spaces back to `{{|}}` when pressing Backspace.

ansibleLens.ansible.rootPaths.description: Explicit Ansible project root directories (relative to the workspace root or absolute) for monorepos that do not contain an `ansible.cfg`.

ansibleLens.documentLinks.enabled.description: Enable clickable document links (underlines) on Ansible module names. Defaults to false so playbooks have zero permanent underlines; hover tooltips always include clickable official documentation links.

ansibleLens.docs.openRenderedPreview.description: When Ctrl+Click (Go to Definition) on a module name opens its read-only ansible-lens-docs page, show it as a rendered Markdown preview instead of raw Markdown.

commands.title: Ansible Lens: Convert File to FQCN

scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ansible-lens-0.1.0.vsix
